turns.teacher: Good morning, children! Very good, all sitting nicely. Today we will do subtraction. Our first sum is fifty two minus twenty seven.
turns.label: other

turns.teacher: Ravi, you said thirty five? No, no, that is wrong. Arjun, you tell.
turns.label: move_on_or_scold

turns.teacher: Arjoon, thirty five again? Listen. The answer is twenty five. Everybody say it with me, twenty five.
turns.label: tell_answer

turns.teacher: See, I told you na, two is small, so we borrow. Two is small, so we borrow. Listen carefully this time, two is small, so we BORROW!
turns.label: repeat_same_way

turns.teacher: Very nice, very nice, good children. Now next sum. Sixty one minus thirty four.
turns.label: new_sum

turns.teacher: Mina, you are counting on fingers again? Twenty eight is not correct. Stop using fingers, we have no time for that.
turns.label: move_on_or_scold

turns.teacher: The answer is twenty seven. Write twenty seven in your notebook. Everyone, twenty seven.
turns.label: tell_answer

turns.teacher: Thumbs up if you got twenty seven. Show me, show me thumbs. Good!
turns.label: check_whole_class

turns.teacher: Okay, one more. Seventy three minus forty six. Quickly, quickly.
turns.label: new_sum

turns.teacher: Again I am saying, one is small, so borrow from the tens. One is small, so borrow from the tens! Very good, you are all my clever children.
turns.label: repeat_same_way
